passage: By Steven Raichlen March 15, 2019. If you’ve ever tasted a thick prime steak dry-aged 4 to 6 weeks (and reverse seared ), you’ve come pretty close to heaven on earth. One of the best dry-aged beef purveyors we know is Chicago Steak Company. We asked Chicago Steak CEO Matt Crowley to share his thoughts on the difference between dry- and wet-aged beef and how to dry-age beef at home.
